cache_id.description: Identifier in the cache file If not empty, configuration specified data will use a separate store keyed by it.

store_fakeip.description: Store fakeip in the cache file

store_rdrc.description: Deprecated in sing-box 1.14.0 store_rdrc is deprecated and will be removed in sing-box 1.16.0, check Migration.

rdrc_timeout.description: Timeout of rejected DNS response cache.

external_ui.description: A relative path to the configuration directory or an absolute path to a directory in which you put some static web resource.

external_ui_download_url.description: ZIP download URL for the external UI, will be used if the specified external_ui directory is empty.

external_ui_download_detour.description: The tag of the outbound to download the external UI.

secret.description: Secret for the RESTful API (optional) Authenticate by spedifying HTTP header Authorization: Bearer ${secret} ALWAYS set a secret if RESTful API is listening on 0.0.0.0

default_mode.description: This setting has no direct effect, but can be used in routing and DNS rules via the clash_mode rule item.

access_control_allow_origin.description: To access the Clash API on a private network from a public website, you must explicitly specify it in access_control_allow_origin instead of using *.

access_control_allow_private_network.description: To access the Clash API on a private network from a public website, access_control_allow_private_network must be enabled.

store_mode.description: Deprecated in sing-box 1.8.0 store_mode is deprecated in Clash API and enabled by default if cache_file.enabled.

store_selected.description: Deprecated in sing-box 1.8.0 store_selected is deprecated in Clash API and enabled by default if cache_file.enabled.

store_fakeip.description: Deprecated in sing-box 1.8.0 store_selected is deprecated in Clash API and migrated to cache_file.store_fakeip.

cache_file.description: Deprecated in sing-box 1.8.0 cache_file is deprecated in Clash API and migrated to cache_file.enabled and cache_file.path.

cache_id.description: Deprecated in sing-box 1.8.0 cache_id is deprecated in Clash API and migrated to cache_file.cache_id.
